凱 concerns the celebration of victory: a victory song or cry, and triumph. Learn it in 凱旋 がいせん, "triumphant return." The character also has a separate dictionary sense of becoming gentle or calm, seen in 凱風 (がいふう), "southerly wind"; do not force the victory meaning into that compound.

Modern-shape mnemonic, not etymology: the left side 豈 resembles 山, "mountain," above 豆 (まめ), "bean." Imagine a victory celebration beside that stacked shape. The right-hand 几 is the indexing radical. This is a memory aid, not a historical or phonetic derivation.

凱旋 がいせん — triumphant return

凱旋 is a triumphant return after victory or success. It is a noun and forms the intransitive verb 凱旋する: the person or team returns. Although associated with returning after victory in battle, it also describes returns after sporting or performing success.
大会で優勝した選手が故国に凱旋した。 (たいかいでゆうしょうしたせんしゅがここくにがいせんした。) — The athlete who won the championship returned to their homeland in triumph.
選手の凱旋を祝った。 (せんしゅのがいせんをいわった。) — We celebrated the athlete's triumphant return.

In the first example, the returning athlete is marked with が and the destination with に. A destination can also take へ. 凱旋する is not a verb for returning an object to its owner. In the second example, 凱旋 is a noun: the return is what people celebrated.

凱 contributes victory celebration or victory music; 旋 (せん) contributes returning in this compound. Together, they describe a return characterized by triumph, not just an ordinary trip back. The on-readings are ガイ + セン. This explanation does not make "return" the only meaning of 旋 in other words.
帰る (かえる), "return home," and 戻る (もどる), "go back," can describe the same movement without expressing triumph. 帰宅 (きたく), "returning home," likewise does not imply success.

優勝 (ゆうしょう), "championship victory," names the winning, not the subsequent return. A person can win without having returned yet. There is no need to treat every unsuccessful return as a fixed opposite word of 凱旋.

Use 凱旋 when the return is presented as a success worth celebrating, not merely for coming home after work. The word does not require that the person won a championship: success in a performance can also motivate a triumphant homecoming.
For recognition, 凱旋公演 (がいせんこうえん) is a performance given after a successful tour abroad. This is not a label for every local concert or every performance after a journey.
